name: Pet groomer

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Bath and brush
services.story: The main story: a $35 bath and brush for Biscuit, priced by his size and coat. A card is saved for the salon's $20 fee and the late pick-up fee. Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Bath and brush
services.story: The same $35 bath and brush for a pet the salon knows. Nothing is taken: a YES books it. Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Matted coat groom
services.story: A matted coat, priced at drop-off once Jamal sees it: a $110 shave-down and a $15 tidy. Only the $25 coat check is promised. A card is saved for the $20 fee.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Full groom in the van
services.story: The main story: a $179 full groom in the van for Maple. A card is saved for the $89 fee, and charged $179 when Nico texts DONE.

services.name: Full groom in the van
services.story: The same $179 van groom. A card is saved for the $89 fee. Rosie texts the bill after, with a tip line.

services.name: Matted coat groom in the van
services.story: A matted coat, priced at the van door: a $165 shave-down and an $80 skin-soothing bath. Only the $89 van visit is promised. The card is charged at DONE.

questions_before_times: Dog or cat, the breed, and about how much the pet weighs
The coat: when it was last groomed, and any mats (a few spots, or tight to the skin)
Has the pet ever bitten or snapped at a groomer?
For the van: the town or ZIP, and a place to park a 24-foot van
safety_stop: a person hurt, or a fire
a pet that's bleeding, can't breathe, collapsed or had a seizure
license: if: where the state licenses grooming businesses (some do, vans and trailers too); none where the state has no grooming license
